options.notes: Fetched by useEnvData as ?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:37). The submitted form value is not the raw id: mapLocationOptions encodes 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when location_type is set and falls back to the bare id otherwise (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36). Static param is repeated (array).

fields.name: ufm_device_id
fields.label: UFM Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the UFM device used to discover port GUIDs.

options.notes: Request suppressed until site is non-empty; the encoded site value is decoded into site=<id> plus site_type=<location_type> query params (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-56). Rows map name -> label, id -> value (useDevices.ts:59-61). No managed_only (UFM appliances are unmanaged) (ui/src/app/workflows/ibportguiddiscoveryworkflow/form/ib-port-guid-discovery-workflow-form.tsx:80-91). Cleared whenever site changes, including on mount (ui/src/app/workflows/ibportguiddiscoveryworkflow/form/ib-port-guid-discovery-workflow-form.tsx:95-98).

client_only_validation: non-empty ('UFM device is required'); schema is string with no minLength

fields.name: switch_device_ids
fields.label: Switch Devices
fields.schema_description: Identifiers of the InfiniBand switches whose interfaces will be synchronized.

options.notes: Request suppressed until site is non-empty; the encoded site value is decoded into site=<id> plus site_type=<location_type> query params (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-56). Rows map name -> label, id -> value (useDevices.ts:59-61). No platform/role filter: lists every managed device at the site, not only IB switches (ui/src/app/workflows/ibportguiddiscoveryworkflow/form/ib-port-guid-discovery-workflow-form.tsx:69-78). Cleared whenever site changes (ui/src/app/workflows/ibportguiddiscoveryworkflow/form/ib-port-guid-discovery-workflow-form.tsx:95-98).

client_only_validation: at least one ('At least one switch device is required'); schema has maxItems 1000 but no minItems

fields.name: dry_run
fields.label: Dry run
fields.description: Compute the UFM-to-DCIM GUID mappings without writing ib_guid back onto any interface. Uncheck to apply the changes.
fields.schema_description: Whether to report changes without updating the DCIM.

payload_transform: params = {ufm_device_id, switch_device_ids, dry_run} straight from form values; site is dropped (ui/src/app/workflows/ibportguiddiscoveryworkflow/form/ib-port-guid-discovery-workflow-form.tsx:103-107). startWorkflow POSTs to /v1/workflow/ngc/ib_port_guid_discovery; 2xx redirects to /workflows/{id} (the following success toast and form.reset() are effectively moot); error -> destructive toast 'Failed to create workflow: <error>' (ui/src/app/workflows/ibportguiddiscoveryworkflow/form/ib-port-guid-discovery-workflow-form.tsx:100-125).
discrepancies: No e2e Playwright spec covers this form; only the docs screenshot loads it (ui/tests/docs-screenshots/workflowForms.spec.ts:446-449).
site is UI-only; IBPortGuidDiscoveryInput has no site field and the value only scopes the device option requests.
No query-param prefill (no useSearchParams), unlike the sibling InfiniBand Cable Validation form that submits the same ufm_device_id/switch_device_ids shape.

Option filters differ from the cable-validation form for the same field names: here UFM = role=UFM (no managed_only) and switches = managed_only=true with no platform filter; cable validation uses platform=UFM and platform=MLNX-OS with no managed_only.
Client-only: ufm_device_id non-empty and switch_device_ids min 1 (schema: no minLength; maxItems 1000 but no minItems).
Labels/descriptions differ from schema: 'UFM Device'/'Ufm Device Id', 'Switch Devices'/'Switch Device Ids', 'Dry run'/'Dry Run'; dry_run help text differs from the schema description.
contract_gaps: BLOCKING for generic: site is not an input-model field, so it cannot carry a UiHint, and depends_on {site: site} cannot reference it because dependencies must name sibling model fields. Generic support needs either a device_reference widget that embeds its own site scope or a UI-only/virtual field concept.

Site option values are encoded 'dcim-location:[type,id]' and must expand into two device query params (site, site_type) (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-50); depends_on maps one field to one query param with the raw value.
Location options need a repeated static param (location_type=Site&location_type=Module); OptionSource.params values are scalar-only.

device_reference on an array field (switch_device_ids) must render a multi-select; the contract does not define device_reference applicability for arrays or how it carries per-field filters (role=UFM vs managed_only=true).
Clearing dependent selections when site changes requires an explicit hint.
